lines: Prof. Shashikanth Suryanarayanan holds shares worth ₹966.75 crore (estimate, valued at offer price); shares, not cash.
Promoter shares above the 20% unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago, so the trigger is recent.
Minimum Promoters' Contribution stays locked until 9 Sep 2027; how many shares unlocked is not extracted.
Confidence is medium: the seller table does not list them, though holdings agree across two sections.
